headline: As of 2026-09-22: 76,129 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 4 of 50 states, D+50.6 registration lean.
bullets: 76,129 early/mail ballots cast so far across 4 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+50.6 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (65,527), North Carolina (7,445), Pennsylvania (2,519).
